title: Through Banksy’s eyes.
text:
The Banksy Museum in Barcelona is one of the most iconic street-urban contemporary spaces that the city offers.  We had the privilege to do a guided visit with the amazing staff-artists. Their work in taking care of this very much needed nowadays, reflecting-provocative art-activism living museum, it’s fundamental. Highly recommended if you around Barcelona and next time for sure we’ll book for the “taller de spray” lab to get our hands “dirty”. 
Ps: Don’t forget to get the kiss pic as a souvenir, in front of the emblematic Kissing Coppers.

title: Would do it again
text:
We were lucky enough to have a private tour of the Banksy Museum with Leila, and it was an exceptional experience. Leila is a passionate, very knowledgeable, and extremely friendly guide. Her explanations were clear, captivating, and full of anecdotes that allow for a better understanding of Banksy's world and the context of his works.

The tour is very well organized, the works are of high quality, and the museum's atmosphere is truly immersive. Thanks to Leila, this tour became a true moment of discovery and reflection.

I highly recommend the private tour to anyone who wishes to have a more
